evals.prompt: Create a 5-slide pitch deck for a SaaS product called 'CloudSync' that syncs files across 10+ cloud services. Include: title slide with tagline, problem slide, solution slide, feature comparison table, and call-to-action. Use professional colors (deep blue and white). Make it visually engaging with minimal text.
evals.expected_output: A .pptx file with 5 slides, proper formatting, readable text, and professional design

assertions.name: no_placeholder_text
assertions.description: No leftover placeholder text like 'XXX', 'Lorem Ipsum', or template defaults

assertions.name: design_consistency
assertions.description: All slides use consistent color scheme and typography

assertions.name: content_accuracy
assertions.description: All required slides present: title, problem, solution, features, CTA

evals.prompt: You have a presentation called 'Q4_Report.pptx' with 10 slides. Update slides 3-5 to include new financial data: Revenue $2.5M, Growth 45%, Profit Margin 28%. Add a chart comparing Q3 vs Q4 performance. Keep the existing design and layout.
evals.expected_output: Updated .pptx file with modified slides 3-5, new chart, and preserved design

assertions.name: slide_count_preserved
assertions.description: Output still has 10 slides after edits

assertions.name: new_data_present
assertions.description: All new financial figures appear in the edited slides

assertions.name: chart_added
assertions.description: Comparison chart between Q3 and Q4 is visible and readable

assertions.name: design_maintained
assertions.description: Original design elements and formatting style preserved

evals.prompt: Extract all text content from the attached deck and create a summary. Flag any missing titles, headers, or content that looks incomplete. Also list the number of slides and identify any visuals or charts that might have issues (overlap, misalignment, etc.).
evals.expected_output: Text extraction report showing all content, completeness assessment, and visual issue flags

assertions.name: content_extracted
assertions.description: All visible text content successfully extracted from slides

assertions.name: completeness_check
assertions.description: Report identifies missing or incomplete content if present

assertions.name: visual_inspection
assertions.description: Report flags potential visual issues like overlapping elements or misalignment
